purpose: Define the minimum deterministic Level Library record needed after rebuilt Level 1 acceptance, without authoring or activating multi-car gameplay early.

activation_guard.current_phase_behavior: schema/validator fixtures only; no Level 3 or production level creation

publishable_invariants: solver proof and parity fixture hashes are present
visible movement rule version is explicit
duplicate fingerprint is present and collision-checked against the target library
visual review is explicit and cannot be inferred from CI
PUBLISHABLE is forbidden while prerequisite finite gates are not PASS

duplicate_detection.canonical_input: normalized logical Level Data only; presentation coordinates/assets are excluded unless they alter gameplay geometry
normalization: strip vehicle IDs after sorting cars by gameplay geometry and resolved exit semantics
strip exit IDs after resolving every car exit reference to exit axis/direction semantics
retain board geometry, movement axes/directions, collision bodies, mechanic state and objective
duplicate_detection.fingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical normalized logical Level Data
duplicate_detection.id_rename_invariant: Renaming level, vehicle, or exit identifiers without changing their resolved logical relationships MUST NOT change the fingerprint.
duplicate_detection.note: Exact logical duplicate detection is an engineering guard, not a claim of perceptual or strategic uniqueness. Symmetric/near-duplicate gameplay requires later structural/human review.

forbidden_claims: CI proves visual quality or fun
